confirmatory_protocol.E_economic_qualification: S passed AND one-sided 97.5% block-bootstrap lower bound of mean top-2 excess > break_even_excess (0.002727); NOT merely > 0
E_informational_only: ROI flat equivalent of mean and of lower bound
confirmatory_protocol.S_scientific_confirmation: one-sided 97.5% block-bootstrap lower bound of mean IC > 0 (block 7, 10000, seed 42)
confirmatory_protocol.evaluation_window: N_target draw hợp lệ đầu tiên có ngày >= holdout start; một lần nhìn; không chấm giữa chừng
confirmatory_protocol.one_shot: score-holdout writes holdout_result.json with mode x; shared with v1 so only one revision can ever score

outcomes.SCIENTIFIC_CONFIRMED_ECONOMIC_QUALIFIED: Control Plane may consider a separate paper-trade comparison; production unchanged by this spec
outcomes.SCIENTIFIC_CONFIRMED_NOT_ECONOMICALLY_QU: retain evidence; no production/paper-trade change; this is the expected outcome if the effect is real but small

forbidden: reading or scoring holdout outcomes before N_target valid draws exist
changing rule, window, K, tie-break, metric, MWU or gate after freeze (new version required)
selecting among variants using holdout data
editing predictions/evaluation_policy.json or prediction_log.json from this module
using S alone as evidence of profitability

holdout_usage_rules.allowed: outcomes of draws strictly before target date T (date < T) as history for the forecast of T
enforcement: forecast_from_lines filters rows by date < T before parsing
scores_all row t uses c[max(0,t-90):t] only (poison test)
validity of a future row never changes the score of T (window = 90 valid rows before T)
row validity is judged only from format (27 values in 0..99), never from outcome
forbidden: scoring or peeking before N_target valid draws exist

limitations: discovery IC/excess are in-sample and selected after seeing all 3 periods (winner curse): true power below nominal
rule IC in VAL 2016-2020 was only 0.0013 vs 0.0064/0.0071 elsewhere: effect not uniform over time
one lottery, one draw/day: E needs hundreds of years at plausible effects; E can only pass for a very large effect
scipy is used but not declared directly in pyproject.toml (transitive via scikit-learn)

minimum_worthwhile_uplift.rationale: about 1.8x break-even excess; smaller uplift is not worth any production/paper-trade change

primary.aggregation: mean over evaluated draws; one-sided 97.5% lower bound by circular block bootstrap
primary.name: mean daily Spearman IC between score and per-number draw count (100 numbers/day)
primary.why: full-ranking accuracy; highest statistical power for one draw/day

secondary.name: top-2 excess hits per pick = mean count of 2 picks - mean count over 100 numbers (same day)
secondary.note: reported with CI; underpowered by design; used only for direction (G3) and for the paper-trade stage

rule.H: sum of f over the 10 numbers sharing the same tens digit (head)
rule.L: sum of f over the 10 numbers sharing the same units digit (tail)
rule.f: count of number n over the 90 valid draws immediately before target date T (rows with date < T)
rule.formula: score[n] = z(H[n//10]) + z(L[n%10]) + z(f[n]); picks = top-2 by score
rule.invalid_rows: rows without exactly 27 values in 0..99 are ignored entirely (not history, not evaluated)
rule.z: per-day cross-sectional standardisation over 100 numbers, population sd; sd==0 -> zeros

sample_size.note: Power 80% chỉ áp dụng cho S (khoảng 82% tại N_target, nếu IC thật = IC của MWU). E gần như không thể đạt trừ khi hiệu ứng thật lớn gấp nhiều lần discovery.

reason: G3 chỉ yêu cầu excess > 0 trong khi break-even là +0.00273: có thể PASS mà ROI kỳ vọng âm
joint power G1-G3 = 63.5%, không phải 80% danh nghĩa; cỡ mẫu 2.561 không được mô tả là 80% cho cả gate
